inputs.original_text: Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for...
inputs.modified_text: Look, what we are seeing here with this proposed legislation from the 2026 State of the State agenda is just a baseline necessity when addressing the systemic crisis of gun violence that ravages our working-class communities and marginalized neighborhoods every single day. For far too long, corporate manufacturers have prioritized profit margins over human lives, flooding our streets with weaponry designed for mass carnage and easily converted into illegal machine guns. While this measure—which would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified and would establish criminal penalties for these conversions—is a step toward reining in corporate recklessness, we have to recognize it as merely a Band-Aid on a deeply wounded, profit-driven system that fundamentally fails to protect vulnerable populations. True public safety won't be achieved through piecemeal regulations alone; it demands a radical institutional overhaul, holding powerful manufacturers accountable for the bloodshed they enable, and dismantling the systemic inequalities that breed violence in the first place.
